overview.description: Founder breakups kill more early companies than technology does, and almost all of them were visible months earlier.
objectives: Have the equity, role and exit conversation before it is urgent
Recognise the drift that precedes a breakup
Structure vesting so a departure is survivable

steps.intro: Founder breakups kill more early companies than technology does, and almost all of them were visible months earlier.
instructions: Write down each founder’s decision rights. Compare answers.
Confirm vesting and acceleration terms are documented and signed.
Agree how a departure would be handled, in writing, now.
